about: A clone gate reads the place as the check folded it, with the same told lines and readings, and never folds it again; it walks the tree only under the top-level entries the release it is weighed against ships, so it names no folder of any toolchain; and it prints what each step took — the rebirth's own steps, then the fold, the lay and walk, the release, the clone and the diff.

cases.name: obligations over X on a copy at epoch 280

red was: a rebirth of three hundred forty-eight seconds
